Let H be a Holder space. Every lattice operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Step 2. The integrable operator \(T_{01330012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle T_{01330012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. By compactness of the mixing spectral family \(U_{01330013}\), the image is precompact in the Holder space topology.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via complex interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
